name: Empty state
blurb: What a list shows before it has anything in it.
mechanism: Static markup. The only decision is which of the three it is - nothing yet, nothing found, or something broke - because the wording changes and the action changes with it.
caveats: Do not use it for errors that need retrying without saying what failed; "No results" and "Search is down" are different states and must read differently.
The icon is decorative and carries aria-hidden; the sentence does the work.
